evidence.justification: The green shaft leaves the bottom of medium pollock around (295,1163), bows left through (284,1235), then passes through (300,1320) and (327,1384). It crosses the large-pollock box as a shaft, with no green arrowhead there. Beyond the label gap it continues through (390,1449), (450,1474), and (513,1485), ending in the green arrowhead at the left edge of predatory fish around (559,1484). Thus the large-pollock box is a crossing, not the origin of this curve.
